questions.q: Structurally, what is a mapping set?
options: A report showing all journal entries for a period
A lookup table that translates one or more input values into a corresponding output value
A type of journal line rule that only applies to tax lines
A setting that controls ledger currency
questions.explain: A mapping set is a reusable lookup table: inputs on one side, the matching output on the other.

questions.q: Why would a consultant use a mapping set instead of writing a separate account rule condition for every possible value?
options: Mapping sets are required by Oracle and account rule conditions don't actually work
To avoid an unwieldy tangle of individual conditions when there are many possible input values, keeping the translation centralized and maintainable
Mapping sets eliminate the need for a Chart of Accounts
Account rules cannot reference any other object
questions.explain: When there are many possible inputs (like dozens of expense categories), a mapping set keeps the translation logic in one organized table rather than many rule conditions.

questions.q: Can a mapping set use more than one input value to determine its output?
options: No, a mapping set can only ever use exactly one input value
Yes, a mapping set can be defined to combine multiple input values, such as expense category and operating company, to produce one output
Only description rules can combine multiple inputs, never mapping sets
Mapping sets cannot be used with account rules at all
questions.explain: Mapping sets can accept more than one input value together and return a single output based on that combination.

questions.q: In the worked example, what output does the mapping set return for an expense line with category "Meals"?
options: Account 6410
Account 6430
Account 6420
No output; Meals is not a valid category
questions.explain: The example mapping set maps Travel to 6410, Meals to 6420, Office Supplies to 6430, and Software to 6440.

questions.q: What is a practical benefit of using a mapping set when a company adds a new expense category next year?
options: The entire account rule must be rebuilt from scratch
Nothing can be done; mapping sets cannot be changed after creation
Someone can simply add a new row to the mapping set rather than modifying the underlying account rule logic
A brand-new subledger application must be registered
questions.explain: Because the translation values live in the mapping set itself, adding a new category is as simple as adding a new row, without touching the account rule.
